descriptions: A Feed Flow (Stream 1), kscmh. Volumetric flow rate of component A in feed stream 1; Supplies reactant A to the process; observation. Sampled every 3 min; input window ends at product sampling time; target report 15 min later; Combines with D, E, and A/C feeds to form reactor feed, Influences reactor pressure, level, temperature, Affects product composition via reaction and separation.

D Feed Flow (Stream 2), kg/h. Mass flow rate of component D in feed stream 2; Supplies reactant D to the process; observation. Sampled every 3 min; input window ends at product sampling time; target report 15 min later; Combines with A, E, and A/C feeds to form reactor feed, Influences reactor conditions and product composition.

E Feed Flow (Stream 3), kg/h. Mass flow rate of component E in feed stream 3; Supplies reactant E to the process; observation. Sampled every 3 min; input window ends at product sampling time; target report 15 min later; Combines with A, D, and A/C feeds to form reactor feed, Influences reactor conditions and product composition.

A/C Feed Flow (Stream 4), kscmh. Combined volumetric flow rate of components A and C in feed stream 4; Supplies reactants A and C to the process; observation. Sampled every 3 min; input window ends at product sampling time; target report 15 min later; Combines with A, D, and E feeds to form reactor feed, Influences reactor conditions and product composition.

Recycle Flow (Stream 8), kscmh. Volumetric flow rate of recycle stream 8; Returns unreacted material from separator to reactor feed; observation. Sampled every 3 min; input window ends at product sampling time; target report 15 min later; Mixes with fresh feeds to form reactor feed (xmeas_6), Recycles unreacted components, affecting reactor composition, Influenced by separator and compressor operation.

Total Reactor Feed Flow (Stream 6), kscmh. Total volumetric flow rate entering the reactor in stream 6; Determines reactor throughput and residence time; observation. Sampled every 3 min; input window ends at product sampling time; target report 15 min later; Sum of fresh feeds (xmeas_1-4) and recycle (xmeas_5), Affects reactor pressure (xmeas_7), level (xmeas_8), temperature (xmeas_9), Influences reaction rates and product distribution.

Reactor Pressure, kPa gauge. Gauge pressure inside the reactor; Key reactor operating condition; state. Sampled every 3 min; input window ends at product sampling time; target report 15 min later; Influenced by feed rates and reactor temperature, Controlled by purge valve (xmv_6) and compressor, Affects reaction equilibrium and rates.

Reactor Liquid Level, %. Percentage of reactor liquid level; Indicates reactor holdup; state. Sampled every 3 min; input window ends at product sampling time; target report 15 min later; Controlled by reactor outlet flow, Affects residence time and reaction conversion, Influences downstream separator and stripper.

Reactor Temperature, degC. Temperature inside the reactor; Critical reaction condition; state. Sampled every 3 min; input window ends at product sampling time; target report 15 min later; Controlled by reactor cooling water valve (xmv_10), Affects reaction kinetics and product distribution, Influenced by feed composition and exothermic heat.

Purge Rate (Stream 9), kscmh. Volumetric flow rate of purge stream 9; Removes inerts and byproducts from the process; observation. Sampled every 3 min; input window ends at product sampling time; target report 15 min later; Controlled by purge valve (xmv_6), Affects inerts accumulation and reactor pressure, Influences material balance and product purity.

Separator Temperature, degC. Temperature inside the product separator; Affects vapor-liquid separation; state. Sampled every 3 min; input window ends at product sampling time; target report 15 min later; Influenced by reactor effluent and separator cooling, Controlled by condenser cooling water valve (xmv_11), Affects product recovery and recycle composition.

Separator Liquid Level, %. Percentage of liquid level in the product separator; Controls separator residence time and phase disengagement; state. Sampled every 3 min; input window ends at product sampling time; target report 15 min later; Controlled by separator underflow valve (xmv_7), Affects liquid flow to stripper (xmeas_14), Important for stable separation.

Separator Pressure, kPa gauge. Gauge pressure in the product separator; Affects separation efficiency and phase equilibrium; state. Sampled every 3 min; input window ends at product sampling time; target report 15 min later; Controlled by compressor and valve positions, Influences separator temperature and product streams, Affects overall pressure profile.

Separator Underflow (Stream 10), m3/h. Volumetric flow rate of liquid leaving the separator (stream 10); Feeds the stripper; observation. Sampled every 3 min; input window ends at product sampling time; target report 15 min later; Controlled by underflow valve (xmv_7), Carries product and unreacted material to stripper, Affects stripper level and product composition.

Stripper Liquid Level, %. Percentage of liquid level in the stripper; Controls stripper residence time; state. Sampled every 3 min; input window ends at product sampling time; target report 15 min later; Controlled by product flow valve (xmv_8), Affects stripping efficiency and product purity, Influenced by separator underflow (xmeas_14).

Stripper Pressure, kPa gauge. Gauge pressure inside the stripper; Affects stripping of light components; state. Sampled every 3 min; input window ends at product sampling time; target report 15 min later; Controlled by overhead valve and steam, Influences stripper temperature and product composition, Affects product flow.

Product Flow (Stream 11), m3/h. Volumetric flow rate of product stream 11 (stripper underflow); Final product stream containing component G; observation. Sampled every 3 min; input window ends at product sampling time; target report 15 min later; Controlled by product flow valve (xmv_8), Directly carries component G to storage, Affects stripper level and product composition.

Stripper Temperature, degC. Temperature inside the stripper; Critical for stripping of light components; state. Sampled every 3 min; input window ends at product sampling time; target report 15 min later; Heated by steam flow (xmeas_19), Controlled by steam valve (xmv_9), Affects product purity and recovery.

Stripper Steam Flow, kg/h. Mass flow rate of steam to the stripper; Provides heat for stripping; observation. Sampled every 3 min; input window ends at product sampling time; target report 15 min later; Controlled by steam valve (xmv_9), Affects stripper temperature (xmeas_18), Influences product composition.

Compressor Work, kW. Power input to the compressor; Compresses recycle gas to maintain system pressure; state. Sampled every 3 min; input window ends at product sampling time; target report 15 min later; Affected by recycle valve (xmv_5), Influences separator and reactor pressure, Impacts energy balance and flow rates.

Reactor Cooling Water Outlet Temperature, degC. Temperature of cooling water leaving the reactor jacket; Indicates heat removal from reactor; observation. Sampled every 3 min; input window ends at product sampling time; target report 15 min later; Controlled by reactor cooling water valve (xmv_10), Reflects heat removal from reactor, Affects reactor temperature (xmeas_9).

Separator Cooling Water Outlet Temperature, degC. Temperature of cooling water leaving the separator condenser; Indicates heat removal from separator; observation. Sampled every 3 min; input window ends at product sampling time; target report 15 min later; Controlled by condenser cooling water valve (xmv_11), Reflects heat removal from separator, Affects separator temperature (xmeas_11).

D Feed Valve Position, %. Valve position for D feed flow control (stream 2); Controls D feed flow rate; control. Sampled every 3 min; input window ends at product sampling time; target report 15 min later; Manipulates D feed flow (xmeas_2), Affects feed composition and reactor conditions.

E Feed Valve Position, %. Valve position for E feed flow control (stream 3); Controls E feed flow rate; control. Sampled every 3 min; input window ends at product sampling time; target report 15 min later; Manipulates E feed flow (xmeas_3), Affects feed composition and reactor conditions.

A Feed Valve Position, %. Valve position for A feed flow control (stream 1); Controls A feed flow rate; control. Sampled every 3 min; input window ends at product sampling time; target report 15 min later; Manipulates A feed flow (xmeas_1), Affects feed composition and reactor conditions.

A/C Feed Valve Position, %. Valve position for combined A and C feed flow control (stream 4); Controls A/C feed flow rate; control. Sampled every 3 min; input window ends at product sampling time; target report 15 min later; Manipulates A/C feed flow (xmeas_4), Affects feed composition and reactor conditions.

Compressor Recycle Valve Position, %. Valve position for compressor recycle stream; Controls compressor recycle flow to manage surge and pressure; control. Sampled every 3 min; input window ends at product sampling time; target report 15 min later; Manipulates compressor recycle flow, Affects compressor work (xmeas_20) and system pressure.

Purge Valve Position (Stream 9), %. Valve position for purge flow control (stream 9); Controls purge rate to remove inerts; control. Sampled every 3 min; input window ends at product sampling time; target report 15 min later; Manipulates purge flow (xmeas_10), Affects inert removal and reactor pressure.

Separator Underflow Valve Position (Stream 10), %. Valve position for separator underflow control (stream 10); Controls liquid flow from separator to stripper; control. Sampled every 3 min; input window ends at product sampling time; target report 15 min later; Manipulates separator underflow (xmeas_14), Affects separator level (xmeas_12) and stripper feed.

Stripper Product Valve Position (Stream 11), %. Valve position for product flow control (stream 11); Controls product flow rate from stripper; control. Sampled every 3 min; input window ends at product sampling time; target report 15 min later; Manipulates product flow (xmeas_17), Affects stripper level (xmeas_15) and product composition.

Stripper Steam Valve Position, %. Valve position for steam flow control to stripper; Controls steam flow to heat stripper; control. Sampled every 3 min; input window ends at product sampling time; target report 15 min later; Manipulates steam flow (xmeas_19), Affects stripper temperature (xmeas_18) and product purity.

Reactor Cooling Water Valve Position, %. Valve position for reactor cooling water flow control; Controls reactor temperature by manipulating cooling water; control. Sampled every 3 min; input window ends at product sampling time; target report 15 min later; Manipulates reactor cooling water flow, Affects reactor temperature (xmeas_9) and cooling outlet temp (xmeas_21).

Condenser Cooling Water Valve Position, %. Valve position for separator condenser cooling water flow control; Controls separator temperature by manipulating cooling water; control. Sampled every 3 min; input window ends at product sampling time; target report 15 min later; Manipulates separator cooling water flow, Affects separator temperature (xmeas_11) and cooling outlet temp (xmeas_22).
